newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to be IMF Thai package's top contributor - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to be IMF Thai package's top contributor - MOF.

text.p: Japan is planning to make the largest contribution among the countries participating in an economic package led by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to help Thailand overcome its economic woes, Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told reporters on Wednesday evening.
He added that financial support from Japan will most likely go through the Export-Import Bank of Japan (Ex-Im).
"I hope that Thailand and the IMF will be able to reach a final agreement on an economic adjustment package as soon as possible," he said.
Japan has received a request from the IMF to help Thailand, and it plans to make a contribution to the Thai package, he said.
Asked about the size of Japan's contribution, Mitsuzuka said that Thailand and the IMF were currently discussing the matter and that he could not comment any further at this point.
